title: Selectatec locking mechanism of TEC vapourisers - adding confusion to the clinical dilemma
abstract:
Different locking mechanism of the Selectatec vapourisers add to the confusion when being mounted on the back bar of the anaesthesia machine. Increased emphasis should be made to standardise the equipment used in anaesthesia to minimize clinical errors and improving patient safety.

DOI: http://dx.doi.org/10.4038/slja.v20i2.3806

Sri Lankan Journal of Anaesthesiology.2012:20(2):104-105
